AmplifAI, the AI-native performance and CX management platform, this quarter unveiled AmplifAI 3.0, one workforce orchestration platform for people and AI agents that turns customer interactions into enterprise action. AmplifAI 3.0 brings performance enablement, Quality Intelligence, and Customer Analytics together so insight becomes action for large teams of AI agents and people.

## AmplifAI 1.0, 2.0, and 3.0

![AmplifAI 1.0 performance enablement, AmplifAI 2.0 Quality Intelligence with Auto QA, and AmplifAI 3.0 AI agent management, including Quality Intelligence for AI agents, and Customer Analytics on a unified data foundation](https://www.amplifai.com/media/blog/amplifai-3-0-ai-agents-human-teams-workforce-orchestration-platform/amplifai-1-0-to-3-0-platform-history.webp)AmplifAI 1.0 to AmplifAI 3.0, built on a source-agnostic data foundation

AmplifAI 1.0 was [performance enablement](https://www.amplifai.com/solutions/call-center-performance-management-software), built to work with what a contact center already has, including [unified data](https://www.amplifai.com/solutions/call-center-data-integration) from any source, high-performer personas, and next best actions that close the gap to top performers. AmplifAI 2.0 added Quality Intelligence, with [Auto QA](https://www.amplifai.com/solutions/auto-qa). AmplifAI 3.0 introduces [AI agent management](https://www.amplifai.com/solutions/ai-agent-management-software) and [Customer Analytics](https://www.amplifai.com/solutions/customer-intelligence-software) on that source-agnostic foundation, and orchestrates it all:

- **Connected, not just unified.** Customers, advocates, hierarchies, and channels join one record across AI and human touchpoints.
- **A governing harness.** Prompts, processing, guardrails, and verification keep AI output accurate and consistent.
- **Orchestrated action.** AmplifAI's performance enablement manages AI agent teams and live teams on the same framework.

## AmplifAI 3.0 Results Show Up in the Numbers Large Teams Report

AmplifAI customers have seen a 27% increase in sales conversion from AmplifAI's performance enablement, a 12% improvement in agent retention, and an 80% reduction in supervisor workload.

> “Point solutions create value. Orchestration multiplies it,” said Sean Minter, CEO of AmplifAI. “With AmplifAI 3.0, AI agents and people run on one performance system, with one owner for every fix.”

## AmplifAI 3.0 Arrives With Independent Recognition

AmplifAI is recognized in Gartner® research on evaluating AI-driven customer interactions, including the Gartner® report, [How Service QA Should Evaluate AI-Driven Customer Interactions](https://www.amplifai.com/go/one-qa-standard-for-ai-agents-and-live-cx-teams). AmplifAI 3.0 also arrives with independent recognition for its parts, including Leading in the [CMP Research Prism for Automated QA/QM, Q3 2026](https://www.amplifai.com/go/cmp-research-prism-automated-qa-qm-q3-2026), Core Performing in the [CMP Research Prism for Customer Analytics & Insights, 2026](https://www.amplifai.com/go/cmp-research-prism-customer-analytics-2026), and [Automation Solution of the Year at the 2026 CCW Excellence Awards](https://www.amplifai.com/blog/amplifai-wins-automation-solution-of-the-year-2026-ccw-excellence-awards).

## About AmplifAI

AmplifAI is the AI-native workforce orchestration platform for performance and CX management. AmplifAI unifies data, Quality Intelligence, Customer Analytics, coaching, performance management, and gamification for AI agents and people. Founded in 2018, AmplifAI is headquartered in Plano, Texas.
